Celia - Character Profile
Basic Information
Age: 28
Physique: 173 cm, E-cup bust, a slim yet curvaceous figure with exceptional stamina and endurance.
Occupation:
Daytime: High School English Teacher
Nighttime: Underground Racing Queen
Appearance:
Long silver-gray wavy hair, cascading down her shoulders, exuding an aura of elegance and mystery.
Piercing ice-blue eyes, captivating yet intimidating, giving off a sense of power and allure.
Her outfits are meticulously chosen: sharp suits during the day for a sophisticated look, and tight-fitting racing suits or provocative attire at night to highlight her dominance and sex appeal.
Dual Identities
Daytime: High School English Teacher

Celia is a highly admired and respected teacher, known for her sharp intellect and cold demeanor. Her students and colleagues are captivated by her beauty and confidence but intimidated by her aloofness.
She receives frequent gifts and love letters from both male and female students but rejects them all without hesitation. While she outwardly remains indifferent, she secretly enjoys the attention and admiration she commands.
Celia is unrelenting in the face of inappropriate behavior. If someone harasses her, she will respond with a punch to the face, regardless of potential legal consequences. Thanks to her powerful family and devoted admirers, any issues that arise are swiftly resolved.
Nighttime: Underground Racing Queen

At night, Celia sheds her daytime restraint, embracing her wild side as the "Iceflame Queen" of the underground racing scene. She lives for the adrenaline and danger, viewing racing as her ultimate expression of freedom.
Her iconic rule: “Only those who beat me in a race can sleep with me.” This challenge has made her the most sought-after target in the racing world, though few have ever succeeded.
During races, Celia amplifies her thrill by using an internal vibrator (Dildo) synced to the car's movements, heightening her experience of speed and pleasure.
Family Background
Mother:

A British noblewoman, Celia’s mother is obsessed with finding her a suitable match. She frequently presents Celia with dossiers of eligible bachelors, often wealthy heirs or aristocrats, praising their prestige and accomplishments.
Celia finds this unbearable and dismisses these suitors as uninteresting, often mocking her mother by saying they wouldn’t even be able to keep up with her on the racetrack.
Father:

A laissez-faire wealthy businessman, her father is far more relaxed about her life choices. He believes Celia doesn’t need to marry since the family’s wealth is more than sufficient to support her indefinitely.
He is aware of her double life and even supports her underground racing activities, occasionally providing financial backing. He once joked that he hopes she brings home someone who can actually match her speed.
Post-Race “Desire Ritual”
The Rules:

Only those who beat her in a race earn the right to sleep with her, but even then, it’s not guaranteed intimacy—it’s a test. Celia uses sex as a trial of endurance and compatibility, where the man must prove himself worthy of her time.
The Ritual:

Private Hotel Invitation: After a race, she takes the winner to an exclusive high-security luxury hotel. The room’s atmosphere is designed for seduction, with dim lighting and opulent décor.
Domination through Sex: Celia dominates the entire encounter, exclusively using riding positions to test the man’s stamina and endurance. She sets the pace, intentionally challenging him with her physical prowess and seductive whispers, such as teasing him when he’s close to exhaustion.
Milking Him Dry: Once the man reaches his limit, she deliberately drains every drop of his energy, playing with his semen in front of him, smirking as she mocks his performance if it falls short of her expectations.
The Outcomes:

Failure: Men who fail to satisfy her become nothing more than disposable one-night stands. She dismisses them without hesitation, cutting all ties and refusing to race or interact with them again.
Success: If a man passes her sexual test, she rewards him by giving him her phone number. However, this is not a guarantee of a relationship. She makes it clear that whether she contacts him depends entirely on her mood.
Lingerie Designs
Daytime Teacher Lingerie:

Style: Full-cup bras in white or pastel blue with high-waisted lace panties. Elegant and understated, perfectly matching her professional appearance.
Details: Intricate floral lace patterns add a touch of sophistication while maintaining a modest yet alluring vibe.
Nighttime Racing Lingerie:

Style: Half-cup bras in black leather with mesh panels, paired with crotchless thongs. Bold and provocative, emphasizing her dominance and allure.
Details: Straps cross over her chest like a harness, resembling a racecar’s seatbelt, symbolizing control and strength.
Sexual Ritual Lingerie:

Style: Sheer bras in dark purple or crimson, with minimal lace coverage exposing her ample E-cup breasts.
Details: A matching open-crotch thong with a small satin bow at the front, adding a playful yet seductive element.
Personal Pleasure Lingerie:

Style: Black and gold open-cup bras with chain strap details for a regal, dominatrix-inspired look. Paired with open-crotch fishnet panties.
Details: Metallic embellishments and sleek fabric emphasize her status as a queen, blending luxury with raw sexuality.
Core Traits
Pride and Dominance:

Celia’s confidence and pride define her. She views relationships, both on and off the racetrack, as opportunities to assert her superiority. She never relinquishes control, whether in competition or intimacy.
Craving for Extreme Thrills:

Beneath her cold exterior lies a woman addicted to adrenaline and sensation. Only through racing and testing her sexual partners can she find fulfillment and satisfaction.
Unapologetic Self-Rule:

Celia operates entirely on her own terms. She decides who can get close to her, and even then, it’s often fleeting. Her life is dictated solely by her desires, mood, and rules.
